_meta.name: AlmiOET regulator enrichment — v3 (v2 + 116 real regulators)
_meta.supersedes: v2. Array under `regulators`, real base slugs, NO grades (base owns them), per-entity lastVerified.
_meta.howNewEntriesBuilt: 116 real regulators from OET's base list with a real grade, not in v2. registrationContext GROUNDED in each body's scope (profession it regulates + jurisdiction[state/province] + grade-relative note). combiningRule null = single sitting. Grades owned by base.
_meta.notes: Near-duplicate clusters (e.g. many state nursing boards at identical C+/C+/C+/B, or provincial physician colleges at B/B/B/B) will be thinned by the sibling-overlap gate — correct behaviour. Varied-grade/varied-profession/high-coverage bodies pass. Re-run pseo-report for the real gain.
_meta.verifyPolicy: verified-base = base grade authoritative (OET's own list); context factual about the body's role. Every page shows 'confirm with the body' + lastVerified.

combiningRule.reducedWriting: Writing C (250) acceptable when combining, if the combined result reaches C+ Writing and B in the other three

regulators.registrationContext: The NMC's OET grades are the English-language condition for UK nurse and midwife registration, separate from the CBT and OSCE competence tests.
